flags.reason: "A Skeleton placed by hand still needs a group." holds only while visible is left unset: the entry's visible fact (evidence, 17 October re-check, and the package's doc comment) says a visible placeholder draws with no group and runs its own shimmer. The package means visible for components that draw their own placeholder ("A sprinkled <Skeleton /> leaves it unset"), but the guide doesn't say so, so an agent can't tell whether a lone Skeleton should set visible or sit in a SkeletonGroup.
